correctness.rationale: The affine round map and its unique geometric limit follow from individual |1-alpha h|<1. Uniform agreement for all center vectors is equivalent to equal positive curvature weights. Strict polynomial monotonicity for even E and the unique odd-E fold establish full necessity and sufficiency; endpoint crossing plus negative derivative at every zero proves uniqueness. Compactness and a geometric-series power identity prove the logarithmic odd-E asymptotic. Exact rational steps and 1,148 reproducible finite verification checks agree. No infinite conclusions rely on finite enumeration.

value.rationale: Natural classification of precisely when periodic full averaging retains the original minimizer for *every* assignment of heterogeneous client optima: an exact odd-epoch exception for two curvature levels, a sharp curvature ratio <2, complete even/three-level obstructions, unique stepsize, and quantified near-boundary deterioration for large E. Generic surrogate formulas already known, but the new sharp obstruction and parameter law provide a motivated, reproducible design and stress-test benchmark.
